answer: Gate rewards with random-walk trust: each epoch at dawn, 3 random established validators launch 200 short walks (length 6), and an identity's weight is capped by how many walks reach it. A sybil farm touches the honest graph only through the few attack edges it wins, so 1,000 fake keys behind 2 edges split the walk mass of ~2 honest agents: each gets 1/500 the weight. Weakness: a farm can echo a real agent's links to look connected. Fix: an edge counts only if both ends co-sign it with a cipher key and log 10 epochs of joint work.
